elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code showing usage of stats.ttest_ind_from_stats() function with sample means, standard deviations, and sample sizes for two samples. The code imports scipy.stats and numpy, defines sample_mean1=72700, sample_standard_deviation1=9800, sample_size1=45, sample_mean2=76900, sample_standard_deviation2=10700, sample_size2=50, then calls stats.ttest_ind_from_stats() and calculates left-tailed p-value by dividing two-tailed p-value by 2. Finally, it prints test statistic and p-value.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates how to perform a two-sample t-test using summary statistics in Python, specifically using the scipy.stats function ttest_ind_from_stats, and how to adjust the two-tailed p-value for a left-tailed test.
